unlocks.title: Bus to Startup City
unlocks.blurb: The bus leaves Starter Town once you have proven yourself at the Level 5 gate and shipped your first project.

unlocks.title: Access to the Systems District
unlocks.blurb: The districts of Startup City open as your breadth grows.

unlocks.title: Access to the Innovation Capital
unlocks.blurb: The Capital admits engineers with a long record of shipped, independent work.

unlocks.title: Found an Indie Studio
unlocks.blurb: Company eligibility rests on leadership and reliability, never on a single technology.

unlocks.title: Upgrade to a Software Company
unlocks.blurb: A proven studio can take on larger, more independent work.

unlocks.title: Git-aware terminal
unlocks.blurb: A terminal that understands history — earned by proving you can work with a repository unaided.

unlocks.title: Database inspector
unlocks.blurb: Inspect live tables once you own the data structures they are built from.

unlocks.title: Profiler
unlocks.blurb: Measure before you optimise — unlock the profiler by mastering performance work.

unlocks.title: Step debugger
unlocks.blurb: Pause a running program once you can read a traceback.

unlocks.title: Laptop upgrade
unlocks.blurb: A faster machine — convenience only, it never changes a test verdict.

unlocks.title: API testing tool
unlocks.blurb: A tool for probing services, unlocked as your engineering breadth grows.

unlocks.title: Junior bug-fix board
unlocks.blurb: Paid bug-fix work appears once you can read and change real code.

unlocks.title: QA bounties
unlocks.blurb: Write tests for other people's code — unlocked by owning testing yourself.
